mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_VERIFY_TOKEN (TOKEN, EMAIL, EXPIRES_AT, USED_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{token}, #{email}, #{expiresAt}, 'N', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN AS "token", EMAIL AS "email" FROM EMAIL_VERIFY_TOKEN WHERE TOKEN = #{value} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFY_TOKEN SET USED_YN='Y' WHERE TOKEN=#{value}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO EMAIL_VERIFIED v USING ( SELECT #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS EMAIL, #{token, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TOKEN FROM dual ) s ON (v.EMAIL = s.EMAIL) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v.VERIFIED_AT = SYSDATE, v.TOKEN = s.TOKEN WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMAIL, TOKEN, VERIFIED_AT) VALUES (s.EMAIL, s.TOKEN, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMAIL_VERIFIED WHERE EMAIL = #{value}
